parity.pick_rule:
on every operand-frame, h1's rule and h0's rule are
  applied to J1's pool and to the dump's pool; the two picks agree when their 480x640 masks have IoU >= 0.95 or both are empty.
  An arm is read only when the pool gate passes and its own picks agree on >= 95% of operand-frames.
parity.rule:
pair the two sides' retained proposals one to one, greedily by mask IoU at 480x640
  (highest first, pairs with IoU >= 0.95 only). An operand-frame matches when every proposal on either side that is clear of the
  numerical boundary (conditional score >= 0.3, the lift floor, and score x presence >= 0.06, 0.01 above the retention floor)
  has a partner; proposals inside the boundary may stay unpaired (bf16 rounding moves them across the 0.05 floor, the cap of 30
  and the order of near-equal low-score queries; the CPU rehearsal showed this tail is where identical code disagrees). Two
  empty lists match. frame_match_strict (same count and every proposal paired) is reported beside it and does not gate.
Pick agreement (pick_match, a second gate per arm, review finding 3.1): on every operand-frame, h1's rule and h0's rule are
  applied to J1's pool and to the dump's pool; the two picks agree when their 480x640 masks have IoU >= 0.95 or both are empty.
  An arm is read only when the pool gate passes and its own picks agree on >= 95% of operand-frames.

definitions.h1:
(per anchor; masks on the (32,240,320) grid):
  h1 (deployable): the retained proposal ranked first by score x presence (one presence per anchor, so the served score
      order, stage1.py:98, routed_features.py:68); kept if it is above both served floors (joint >= 0.05 and score >= 0.3);
      empty otherwise. Ties keep the served order (the earlier stored proposal).
  h0 (pool oracle): among all retained proposals of the anchor, the one with the highest IoU against the bound GT instance
      on the grid; kept if IoU >= 0.5; empty where GT is empty or no proposal reaches 0.5. Ties keep the earlier proposal.
  k (box oracle): SAM 3's top-scoring mask for the GT instance's tight box (box_from_mask) as its only prompt, on every
      anchor where GT is non-empty; empty where GT is empty.
definitions.parity:
(match, detail) for one operand-frame under the registered rule: every proposal clear of the boundary, on either side,
    has a one-to-one partner with IoU >= thr; boundary proposals may stay unpaired.
definitions.reading:
for X in h1, h0, k, on all 117 items (the only population that decides):
  X - a with relift's Bootstrap (10,000 physical-room draws, seed 20261120, item weighting); share (X-a)/(e-a) (ratio of item means,
  interval from the same draws); verdict: X - a >= 8 with lower bound > 0 -> source (h0, k: opens); X - a <= 4 with upper bound
  < 8 -> closes; else undecided. Per dataset (ARKit, ScanNet, ScanNet++), the same numbers with item and room counts, not deciding.
  Per-frame precision/recall at the anchors against the bound GT instance for a, e, h1, h0, k per dataset, over (item, operand,
  anchor) with GT or prediction non-empty: precision = mean |P&G|/|P| over anchors with P non-empty; recall = mean |P&G|/|G| over
  anchors with G non-empty; plus the count of anchors where the arm has a mask and GT is empty.
  For each undecided arm: select_j1.needed_items (paired items and rooms to clear the nearer bar at the observed per-room spread
  and mean) and the rooms that could supply them: the manifest's items outside the 117 with relift's exclusion reasons. R0-dev
  stays unspent.
